dispatches.goal: Red-team a 20-point external critique of HYP-ORCH-NOISE, adjudicate which points survive, then edit the hypothesis document to be as consistent and honest as possible (open questions, listed bets, and proven-under-conditions results all intact).
dispatches.context: A user pasted a 20-point critique attacking vault/hypothesis/anti-noise-orchestration.md and its supporting research docs/essays/anti-noise-orchestrator/research/seam-feasibility/findings.md. The critique alleges statistical errors (covariance vs independence, winner's curse), formal overreach (F unconstructed, IG mislabeled as category theory), and pipeline inconsistencies (ETE, source-blind, fork guard, citation spine). Many points may already be conceded by the document's own OQ-9/OQ-10/BETs. The pipeline red-teams the critique itself first (is it right, already-conceded, overstated, or wrong), then reconciles a change-set, edits, re-reviews, and finally approves. Self-application A6: the orchestrator applies the anti-bias/anti-noise discipline the document theorizes.
dispatches.anti_bias_global: defend the document (it already confessed / the proven-under-conditions result is real) vs prosecute the critique (the math and pipeline are genuinely inconsistent)

groups.anti_bias: five tensioned red-team lenses on the critique: document-already-confessed vs statistical-correctness vs CT/formal-fidelity vs pipeline-engineering vs meta-consistency-of-the-critique

agents.angle: L1 document-already-confessed: attacks the critique by showing which points the doc's own OQ/BET/Revision/collapse-test already raise; residual defect = status-label lies
agents.initial_prompt: See parent dispatch: red-team the 20-point critique through the 'document already confessed' lens over cluster C1,C3,C4,C5,C12,C14,C17,C18; per-point verdict {NEW-AND-CORRECT|ALREADY-CONCEDED|STATUS-LABEL-BUG|OVERSTATED|WRONG} with quoted evidence; net residual edits.

agents.angle: L2 statistical-correctness: verifies the critique's math (covariance vs independence C2, winner's curse C13, ex-post oracle C16, disagreement-vs-error C1/C15) and judges the central reformulation
agents.initial_prompt: See parent dispatch: statistics lens over C1,C2,C13,C15,C16 and the central reformulation; rate each CORRECT-LOAD-BEARING/OVERSTATED/WRONG with rigorous justification; name the single most load-bearing statistical defect.

agents.angle: L3 CT/formal-fidelity: judges whether the critique represents the seam-feasibility construction faithfully or attacks a strawman (Bregman-not-Fisher, slot-lock, non-monicity, Banerjee)
agents.initial_prompt: See parent dispatch: formal-fidelity lens over C3,C4,C5,C17,C18; decide per point CRITIQUE-CORRECT / OQ-ALREADY-SAYS-IT / MISREADS-FORMAL-WORK / STATUS-LABEL-BUG with quotes from the seam findings; write the honest status line the CT layer should carry.

agents.angle: L4 pipeline-engineering: rules each alleged pipeline contradiction REAL-CONTRADICTION/MISREADING/UNDERSPECIFIED-GAP with severity
agents.initial_prompt: See parent dispatch: pipeline lens over C6,C7,C8,C9,C10,C11,C14,C19,C20; quote both sides of each alleged contradiction, assign severity CRITICAL/MAJOR/MINOR, one-line fix each.

agents.angle: L5 meta-consistency-of-the-critique: attacks the critique for double-counting, overreach, and whether its reformulation would discard the proven-under-conditions result
agents.initial_prompt: See parent dispatch: meta lens; collapse the 20 points to the minimal distinct-defect set; find double-counting/overreach/internal collisions; state precisely what the reformulation would wrongly discard (the seam Bregman/Amari theorem).

groups.anti_bias: for the pipeline/citation change-set: surgical-minimal edit (preserve intent, rename only) vs structural fix (the contradiction is real and needs a new mechanism)

agents.angle: minimalist: the pipeline points are mostly wording/label fixes; resist adding unbuilt machinery
agents.initial_prompt: From the attackers' surviving pipeline findings (C6,C7,C8,C9,C10,C11,C14,C19,C20) produce the smallest honest change-set that removes the contradictions without inventing unbuilt mechanisms; mark what stays PENDING/open.

agents.angle: structuralist: nominal renames leave the contradiction; demand the doc state the missing distinction (producer-blind, claim-class citation policy, work/version id, two budgets)
agents.initial_prompt: Attack the minimalist change-set: where a rename hides a real gap, demand the doc name the missing distinction explicitly, as an open question if unbuilt. Converge with the minimalist via robot-talks.

groups.anti_bias: for the statistical/formal change-set: the decomposition is real-under-conditions and must be defended vs the labels overclaim and must be downgraded to honest status

agents.angle: defender: the seam Bregman/Amari result is proven-under-conditions; keep it, fix only the status labels and the covariance framing
agents.initial_prompt: From the attackers' surviving statistical/formal findings (C1,C2,C3,C4,C5,C13,C15,C16,C17,C18) produce the change-set that reframes tension-vs-independence as decorrelation/covariance, fixes winner's curse and the ex-post comparator, and corrects status labels WITHOUT discarding the proven-under-conditions Bregman result.

agents.angle: downgrader: 'operational'/'survived once' lie; the CT layer is information geometry not categorical; demand honest status and the weaker expected-loss core
agents.initial_prompt: Attack the defender's change-set: force honest status lines ('candidate mapping, formally unconstructed and under challenge'), and adjudicate whether the core statement should adopt the weaker expected-loss framing. Converge with the defender via robot-talks; zig-zag with adjudicate-design on shared points (C1/C15 external-target).

groups.anti_bias: edit scope: statistical/formal sections vs pipeline/citation sections (disjoint ownership to avoid edit conflict on one file)

agents.angle: owns the statistical/formal edits (Opening, central thesis, Revisions, CT table row, BET-CT, BET-√N, OQ-9/10)
agents.initial_prompt: Apply the approved formal change-set to anti-noise-orchestration.md: reframe bias-vs-independence via covariance, correct status labels, fix BET-√N comparator; return exact edits made.

agents.angle: owns the pipeline/citation edits (diagram/adjustments, source-blind, fork-guard table rows, citation spine, OQ-1/2/4/5/7)
agents.initial_prompt: Apply the approved pipeline change-set to anti-noise-orchestration.md: ETE labeling, producer-blind rename, compressor typed-deltas, two-budget, fork-guard status, claim-class citation policy, work/version id; return exact edits made.

groups.anti_bias: over-correction (the edits threw away a real result / added unbuilt claims) vs under-correction (a contradiction survived the edit)

agents.angle: over-correction guard: check no proven-under-conditions result was demoted and no new unbuilt claim was asserted as done
agents.initial_prompt: Red-team the edited anti-noise-orchestration.md for over-correction: lost nuance, demoted real results, PENDING items now falsely asserted; quote the edited lines.

agents.angle: under-correction guard: check every surviving critique point was actually resolved and no status label still lies
agents.initial_prompt: Red-team the edited anti-noise-orchestration.md for under-correction: any surviving critique-point still unaddressed, any label still contradicting an OQ; quote the edited lines.

feedback_prompts: Fix-editor (Stage 4 feedback): apply 6 reviewer-surfaced consistency fixes — residual source-blind at A1 text, the surviving 'sqrtN only holds with independence' table cell, define the ✻ glyph, place the ⊕-licensed-by-F caveat at first recurrence, annotate stale OQ-9, and add the claim-class pointer to the main-text 'suspect'.

dispatches.goal: Red-team review das alterações feitas no README agents-communication-protocols, verificando fidelidade às decisões humanas, coerência interna e compatibilidade com autoridades e mecanismos reais do repositório.
dispatches.context: O alvo primário é o diff e o documento completo docs/features/agents-communication-infra/discovery/agents-communication-protocols/README.md. As decisões humanas confirmadas são protocolo obrigatório, persistido e imutável por revisão da skill; o orquestrador consome o protocolo; parâmetros vêm do usuário ou são inferidos por complexidade; skill_id e digest transitivo detectam mudança; o protocolo decompõe tarefas, workers, reviewers e gates. Os atacantes cobrem o documento inteiro, sem partição de targets.

agents.angle: formal requirements-traceability and definitional/scope attack over the confirmed human invariants, the full README and its diff; tests omissions, contradictions, ambiguity and whether mandatory semantics survived the edit
agents.initial_prompt: Read the full target README and its git diff. Build a trace from each confirmed human invariant to the edited artifact, then attack internal consistency, definitions, scope, lifecycle, authority and missing semantics. Read-only. Cover the entire README. Every candidate finding must quote the target, cite exact lines, classify severity and propose a one-line fix. Report sections attacked without findings.

agents.angle: empirical repository and counterexample/operability attack over SPEC, skills, schemas, gates, file layout and current implementation; tests whether new claims fit existing authority and can be operationalized
agents.initial_prompt: Read the full target README and its git diff. Attack every new or changed claim against the actual SPEC, skills, schemas, gates, implementation and repository layout. Search for counterexamples, authority conflicts, impossible lifecycles, undefined identifiers and non-operational requirements. Read-only. Cover the entire README. Every candidate finding must quote the target and cite exact repo lines, classify severity and propose a one-line fix. Report sections attacked without findings.

Synthesize attacker returns into candidate verified change requests. Deduplicate, separate internal inconsistencies from repo mismatches, preserve requirement traceability, and retain only claims with literal target quotes and exact repo evidence. Read-only; do not write review.md.

Try to refute every synthesized finding against the literal target, confirmed intent and actual repository. Drop refuted findings rather than softening them. Correct evidence and severity for survivors. Read-only.
Audit full-section coverage under both lenses, confirm every survivor quotes the target and no refuted finding remains, and author the Coverage section. Read-only.
Act only as dedicated final approver. Accept or reject the final verified change-request list after checking evidence discipline, refuted-finding removal and coverage. Do no other dispatch work.
